# Daily Driver — parts inventory

**Generated by `build.py` — do not hand-edit; add/remove parts in `build.py`.**

**17 parts total** — 4 printed · 7 accessory · 2 fit coupon · 4 reference. A full `build.py` / `gate.py` run reports **17/17**. Sourcing + quantities are in `BOM.md`.

## Printed

| Part | Output | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `cup` | STL + STEP | earcup shell — integral lattice grille, baffle bosses, pivot bosses, pad lip |
| `baffle` | STL + STEP | front driver plate — aperture, guard, controlled vents, driver seat + collar |
| `yoke` | STL + STEP | fork — tilts on the cup pivot, carries the height-adjust post |
| `slider` | STL + STEP | headband clamp + post barrel — height lock (knob → shoe → post) + swivel |
